verdict.rationale: Paxos docs state that it publishes monthly reports on reserve composition and attestation reports for USDG, and that USDG is redeemable 1:1 for USD. That covers the reserve and attestation part of the story, though only through brief single mentions. Missing for 10: any documented yield or rewards program with eligibility terms and regulatory caveats, detail on reserve composition beyond the existence of the reports, equivalent disclosures for PYUSD and USDP, and independent corroboration.
